verdict: ROAS surged 59% this week; purchase volume needs to grow to hold it.
narrative: Your Meta ads returned $4.94 for every $1 spent over the last 28 days, and that efficiency jumped 59% week-over-week — a real improvement, not a rounding error. The base is still thin at 39 purchases on $1,392.59 in spend, which means a single slow week can swing the number meaningfully, so the focus now is building more consistent purchase volume. Short-term purchase signals from the last few days are trending in the right direction. In parallel, several planned deliverables — including email flows, subscribe pages, and funnel tracking — are being pushed through to completion this month, which should strengthen the full funnel behind the ads. Expect a clearer picture of landing-page performance once those pieces are live.
